Let \(x=a-b>0\) and \(y=b-c>0\). Then \(a-c=x+y\), and the inequality becomes

\[
\frac1x+\frac1y \ge \frac{k}{x+y}
\]

or

\[
(x+y)\left(\frac1x+\frac1y\right) \ge k.
\]

Now

\[
(x+y)\left(\frac1x+\frac1y\right)
=2+\frac{x}{y}+\frac{y}{x}
\ge 2+2=4.
\]

Thus the inequality always holds precisely when \(k\le 4\), so the largest integer is

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
